name: Burden
overview: The Bible portrays burdens both as literal and figurative weights that individuals and nations carry, often representing oppression or divine judgment, as seen in the prophetic 'burdens' pronounced against Babylon, Moab, Damascus, and Egypt in Isaiah. At the same time, Scripture encourages believers to cast their personal burdens upon the Lord, who sustains and upholds the righteous, exemplifying God's care and provision (Psalms 55:22). Furthermore, Isaiah highlights God's desire to free the oppressed by undoing heavy burdens and breaking yokes, pointing to the spiritual and practical release found in His deliverance. The theme of bearing one another's burdens also underscores the communal responsibility within the body of Christ to support and restore one another.
